subject: Physics
b6_reason: EM waves are radiated by accelerating (not uniformly moving) charges, so option 4 is the property that does not hold; the other three are standard true properties.
b6_working: Transverse: true. Equal electric and magnetic energy densities in free space: true. Speed = 1/sqrt(mu_0*epsilon_0): true. Origin from uniformly moving charges: false, uniform velocity gives no radiation.
b6_note: Option 3's notation is garbled ('00 1$\mu\varepsilon$'), evidently 1/sqrt(mu_0*epsilon_0); it is a true property either way, so the choice is unaffected.
